intro.h2: Clean, precise tile work, start to finish
paragraphs: Palencia Tile handles bathroom tile installation in Ivins, UT, along with kitchen and bathroom backsplashes, tile floors and feature walls. One homeowner spent a long time looking for someone whose work and pricing she liked before hiring us to remodel her bathroom tile. She calls us very honest and professional and says we are the company she will use from now on.

Recent customers say the same thing in their own words. One describes an installation that was clean, precise and done efficiently, by a team that clearly has experience and cares about the craft. Another says we made the process smooth from start to finish and that the result exceeded their expectations.

items.name: Bathroom tile
items.blurb: From the floor to the shower walls, bathroom tiling is one of the topics in our Google reviews. The bathroom shown here went from worn beige tile and carpet to wood-look porcelain planks laid in a staggered pattern, with tight, even grout lines from the shower to the door.

image.alt: Bathroom floor of wood-look porcelain plank tile in a staggered pattern between the shower and the door

items.name: Backsplashes
items.blurb: Backsplash installation comes up in five of our Google reviews. This vanity backsplash uses glossy greige subway tile in a running bond above a white and gray quartz top, set between dark wood wall cabinets. Kitchen backsplashes get the same careful layout and clean cuts.

image.alt: Glossy greige subway tile backsplash being installed above a white and gray quartz vanity top, below dark wood cabinets

items.name: Tile floors
items.blurb: Google lists us as a flooring contractor, and tile floors are a big part of that work. Whether you want porcelain, ceramic or a wood-look plank, tell us the rooms and the look you are after, and we will help you plan the layout and the transitions.

items.name: Feature walls and fireplaces
items.blurb: Tile is not only for wet rooms. This floor-to-ceiling feature wall uses a linear glass and stone mosaic in browns, grays and copper tones around a mounted TV and a long electric fireplace, finished cleanly at every edge and opening.

image.alt: Floor-to-ceiling linear glass and stone mosaic tile wall around a mounted TV and an electric fireplace

about.text: Palencia Tile is a tile and flooring contractor serving Ivins, Utah. We install bathroom tile, backsplashes, tile floors and decorative feature walls, and our Google profile holds more than 120 photos of that work. Our reviews span six years, from a bathroom tile remodel for a homeowner who had searched a long time for the right company to recent jobs praised as clean, precise and efficient. Customers return to the same few words: punctual, professional, honest and reliable. Call us Monday through Friday from 8:30 AM to 6 PM, or Saturday from 10 AM to noon.

steps.title: Call us
steps.text: Call (435) 915-0062 Monday through Friday between 8:30 AM and 6 PM, or Saturday morning, and tell us about your room.

steps.title: Pick tile and layout
steps.text: We look at the space with you and talk through tile, pattern and layout options that suit the room and your budget.

steps.title: Prep the room
steps.text: Old tile, carpet and trim come out and the floor or wall is prepared, as our bathroom project photos show.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: We set the tile cleanly and precisely, arriving on time and keeping the job moving efficiently from day to day.

steps.title: Final look
steps.text: We go over the finished tile with you, from grout lines to edges, so the result matches what you pictured.

service_area.text: Palencia Tile works with homeowners in Ivins, Utah. If you live nearby and are not sure whether your project is in our range, call (435) 915-0062 during our business hours and ask us. Tell us where the home is and what you want tiled, whether a bathroom, a backsplash, a floor or a feature wall, and we will let you know.

items.a: We install bathroom tile, kitchen and bathroom backsplashes, tile floors and decorative feature walls like the mosaic fireplace wall on our Google profile. Backsplash installation comes up in five of our reviews, and bathroom tiling is mentioned too. Call us if you are not sure your project fits.

items.q: Can you replace carpet in a bathroom with tile?
items.a: Yes. Our project photos show a bathroom where the old beige tile and a strip of carpet came out and wood-look porcelain planks went in, running from the shower to the door. Tell us about your floor and we will talk through tile options and layout.

Punctuality is one of the topics customers bring up in our Google reviews, with six reviews mentioning it. Customers also call us reliable and say the process ran smoothly from start to finish. If anything changes with your schedule, just call and let us know.

We are open Monday through Friday from 8:30 AM to 6 PM and Saturday from 10 AM to noon, and closed on Sunday. Call (435) 915-0062, or email palenciatilellc@gmail.com with photos of the space and the tile you like, and we will get back to you.

items.q: How do I get an estimate?
items.a: Call us or use the estimate form on this page. Send a few photos of the room, rough measurements and any tile you already have in mind. We will follow up to set a time to see the space and talk about the work and the price.

final_cta.text: Call Palencia Tile to talk about your bathroom, backsplash or floor.
